exposure: Women who delivered exclusively by Caesarean Section (CS)
cohort: 242 vaginally nulliparous women who presented to a tertiary urogynaecology unit with symptoms and signs of pelvic floor dysfunction between 2006 and 2014
finding: Compared to nulliparas, women who delivered exclusively by CS showed increased pelvic organ descent on Valsalva and tissue displacement on PFMC, implying increased tissue elasticity/ compliance or reduced stiffness, consistent with a small permanent hormonal and/or mechanical effect of pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women who delivered exclusively by CS showed increased pelvic organ descent on Valsalva and tissue displacement on PFMC compared to nulliparous women.
